title: Wheel build selects the CI probe manifest
root_cause: The workflow runs the build in ci, selecting the probe pyproject.toml and setup.py instead of the service package configuration. The compiler error about probe.c is a symptom of building the wrong project, not a failure of the intended service build.

relevant_evidence.why: The job defaults commands to ci.
The intended service project resides under service.
The CI probe defines the native extension and source seen in the error.
The visible compiler failure comes from building the probe.
The selected directory and project name identify the shadowing configuration.
